text_block_list.text:
I accompanied Tap Dance City and the 
others as the chaperone for their barbecue 
party, but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Tap, you come over here too~♪ 
Let's dance our hearts out around the 
campfire!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I'll pass. I just feel like 
enjoying a calm, peaceful day today."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Normally, you'd be the first to start 
dancing... Well, come on over if you feel 
like it!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I wonder when this fatigue will 
finally go away.

"Perhaps fatigue from the races is 
catching up with her. It might be best to 
reconsider her schedule."
